app.name: Axiom
app.description: The brutally honest financial decision companion. Type a scenario. Get the truth.

dashboard.title: Can you afford it?
dashboard.subtitle: Describe a purchase in plain language. Axiom extracts the numbers, calculates the real cost, and tells you if it fits your life — no judgment, just math.
dashboard.placeholder: Can I afford a $40k Tesla Model 3 with $5k down over 60 months, earning $8k/month?
dashboard.example1: Can I afford a $40k Tesla Model 3 with $5k down over 60 months, earning $8k/month?
dashboard.example2: Can I afford a $110k BMW M5 earning $2k/month with $5k down?
dashboard.example3: Can I afford a $150k studio apartment with $30k down over 30 years at 4.5%?

analyze.preliminaryDesc: Complete your profile for an accurate score.

projections.title: 10-Year Projection
projections.subtitle: Comparing the purchase path vs. investing the difference. The crossover shows when investing overtakes the asset value.
projections.crossoverDesc: Investment value surpasses asset residual value

history.title: Scenario History
history.empty: No scenarios yet. Analyze your first purchase to see it here.

profile.title: Financial Profile
profile.subtitle: Your baseline for accurate scoring
profile.whyDesc: Your profile makes the Sanggup Score ~40% more accurate. Without it, scores use conservative defaults and show a "Preliminary" badge. We never share this data — it stays in your browser.

monthlyIncome.label: Monthly Net Income
monthlyIncome.help: After tax, what hits your account

emergencyFund.label: Emergency Fund
emergencyFund.help: Cash you can access in 24 hours

monthlySavings.label: Monthly Savings Rate
monthlySavings.help: What you actually save each month

existingDebt.label: Existing Monthly Debt Payments
existingDebt.help: Student loans, car payments, credit cards

investmentReturn.label: Expected Investment Return (%/year)
investmentReturn.help: Conservative annual return for opportunity cost calc

dti.title: Debt-to-Income Ratio
dti.desc: Your monthly debt payments as % of income. Under 36% is healthy.

tco.title: Total Cost of Ownership
tco.desc: All-in cost over the loan term including hidden costs.

opportunity.title: Opportunity Cost
opportunity.desc: What you'd have if you invested the monthly payment instead.
